resources.purpose: Job seeker profile that drives search keywords and email drafting
Target companies with match evidence, drafted email, and outreach status
Contact addresses discovered per company, several per company

vaultRequirements.purpose: SMTP server host for the job seeker's own mailbox
SMTP username, usually the sender address itself
SMTP app password / authorization code. Never an account password

trustedExecution.setup: scripts/setup.mjs — creates or adopts the Folder and Bases, then reads them back
trustedExecution.profile: scripts/build_resume.mjs — renders the profile into a typeset PDF resume
trustedExecution.smtpSetup: scripts/configure_smtp.mjs — writes SMTP credentials into the Busabase Vault
trustedExecution.leadImport: scripts/import_leads.mjs — Agent writes discovered companies and contact addresses
trustedExecution.emailSend: scripts/send_emails.mjs — resolves credentials from the runtime environment or the local Vault, sends approved outreach, marks it sent; --test-to rehearses without writing
browserWrites: outreach approval verdict and drafted email
